# Yoosuf Mohamed

> Full-stack software engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, with over a decade of experience building web applications. Specialises in TypeScript, React, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, AWS, ElasticSearch, Redis, GraphQL, and Microservices.
